deploy-bot: Deploy rollup started -> environment=staging, change_window=2026-03-20T02:00:00Z/2026-03-20T03:00:00Z, author=jdoe
deploy-bot: Targets: runtime=runtime:v1.12.0, api=api:v2.3.5, console=console:v0.9.8; tag/commit refs: runtime@a1b2c3d, api@d4e5f6g, console@h7i8j9k
katherine: quick check — is DB migration included for api:v2.3.5?
deploy-bot: No DB migrations for api:v2.3.5; compatibility matrix OK per release notes https://go/release/RI-1245
josh: watching 95th for api during deploy, will flag if >200ms
marco: starting runtime rollout (canary 10%)
deploy-bot: runtime (runtime:v1.12.0) -> canary start -> nodeset=gn5-2, rollout_id=rl-177210

marco: runtime looks good on canary, no KV cache regressions seen
deploy-bot: runtime -> promoted to 100% -> finished OK (latency p95 decreased by 12ms)
deploy-bot: api (api:v2.3.5) -> canary start -> nodeset=api-sg-1, rollout_id=rl-177211
deploy-bot: api[canary] -> healthcheck FAIL (502) on 2/5 pods
josh: seeing 502s from /v1/generate, stacktrace points to new token validation middleware
katherine: rolling back api canary and pining to api:v2.3.4 for staging. We should hold console until api is stable.
eng-release: Agreed. Patch required for middleware compatibility, create a hotfix branch and notify QA. Opening ticket: RI-1302
deploy-bot: api[canary] -> rollback to api:v2.3.4 -> rollback finished OK (all pods healthy)
deploy-bot: api pinned to api:v2.3.4 in staging org-wide until hotfix lands (pin reason: 502s introduced by token middleware)
marco: console rollout paused manually by @katherine — console depends on api contract change
katherine: @oncall please escalate if we see any production traffic hitting the new api tag, but staging only impacted for now :eyes:
oncall: acknowledged, I added alert suppressions for staging noisy errors and will watch prod endpoints
josh: captured logs and a small repro for the middleware issue, attaching gist: https://gist.github.com/josh/ri-1302-debug
eng-release: release notes updated with rollback + pin details: https://go/release/RI-1245/notes; will include hotfix plan and expected ETA: 2h
deploy-bot: Deploy rollup summary -> runtime: success (v1.12.0), api: rolled back to v2.3.4 (attempted v2.3.5), console: held (v0.9.8 pending), change_window: still open until 2026-03-20T03:00:00Z
katherine: good call holding console. Once hotfix is merged we can resume api canary and then schedule console.
marco: tagging follow-up: pin applied via config-service (config pin api: v2.3.4) and annotated in deployment history rl-177211
josh: will push a small patch branch and request an expedited E2E run in QA env
eng-release: I'll coordinate a short rollback postmortem and add the incident note to the release ticket
deploy-bot: Deploy rollup closed for staging (summary URL: https://go/deploys/1772100456)
katherine: thanks team :thumbsup: let’s aim to have hotfix + canary by 04:00Z
marco: noted, will watch the canary metrics and coordinate with infra for extra capacity if needed
eng-release: marking this thread for follow-up and tagging RI-1302 and RI-1245 in the epic
deploy-bot: final status -> all actions recorded, pins in place, rollback applied, open follow-ups: [RI-1302]
